name: Ayya Cittananda
reason: No website of her own: she is the second resident nun at Karuna Buddhist Vihara (karunabv.org), founded and led by Ayya Santussika (rank 61, planned). The vihara's programmes, contact and YouTube channel go on Santussika's listing; none of the first 30 channel videos are hers and no items, books or usable photo of her own were found, so a separate listing would be too thin and would duplicate the vihara's items. She is named in Santussika's bio.
